shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C4 "calendar\|date-components\|date-utils" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,150p; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components dist-tags --json 2>&1 | head -20; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@latest peerDependencies version --json 2>&1 | head -30

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"[0-9]*\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tr -d '"' | awk -F. '{a[$1]=$0} END{for(k in a)print a[k]}' | sort -V; for v in 2 3 4; do echo "== major $v"; npm view "@gravity-ui/date-components@$v" version peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -6; done

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar 2>&1 | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar 2>&1 | head -40; git diff package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls dist/docs dist/docs/* | head -40; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "required setup\|## Install" README.md | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -rn "loadLocale\|setLocale" date-utils/build/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "lang" uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "Flex\b\|Card\b" uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
ls date-utils date-utils/build 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rn "loadLocale" date-utils --include=*.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "lang" uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head
